title: fix(app-shell): the Setup position page previews each permission set it names, read-only (#26187)
body:
Fixes #26187

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
改了什么:Setup → 岗位页面上,岗位列出的每个权限集各显示一个只读的权限预览(对象 × 增删改查、读写记录范围、字段、行级策略),按岗位列出的顺序排列,标题是权限集名并链接到该权限集页面;找不到的权限集只显示一行「未找到」,岗位没列权限集时显示空状态。
为什么改:#26187 的裁决(Q1)要求岗位页能看到权限集授予的范围;之前岗位页只列权限集名字,管理员必须逐个打开权限集才知道岗位到底给了什么。权限集页面本身已由 PR 1(#26284)的矩阵选择器显示范围,席位裁定不再加第二份只读副本。
风险与回滚:只改 app-shell 的岗位页面(新增一个只读区块 + 环境区块从单个改为列表)和 i18n 新键,不改任何写入、规范或接口;最坏情况是岗位页多出一个显示不对的区块,不影响保存。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PositionPermissionSetsSection.tsx`(风险 hunk:按名读取权限集的 effect,404 → 未找到、其它错误 → 拒绝原文)→ `ResourceEditPage.tsx`(`ENVIRONMENT_SECTIONS` 改为数组并把页面草稿传入)→ `i18n.ts`(en + zh 各 7 个新键)。
两分钟验证:在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PositionPermissionSetsSection.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.positionPermissionSets-26187.test.tsx --maxWorkers=2`,预期 `Test Files 2 passed (2)` / `Tests 9 passed (9)`;或打开 `/apps/setup/metadata/position/POSITION_NAME?scope=environment`,持有人区块下方出现「Permission sets」区块。
需要你做的:无,席位落地

## What changes

PR 2 of 2 (PR 1, the matrix scope pickers, merged as #26284). This PR touches the position page only: the seat ruled that the permission-set page needs no second, read-only preview, because its matrix already shows each object's read and write scope since PR 1.

- **New `PositionPermissionSetsSection`** (`metadata-admin/PositionPermissionSetsSection.tsx`). On the Setup position page (environment scope, not create mode, not embedded), under the definition and after the holders, it renders one `PermissionPreview` per permission set the position names in `permissionSets`:
  - in declared order, each under an `h3` with the set's name, linking to `../../permission/NAME` (path-relative, keeping `?scope=environment`), so the link lands on the set's own page in the same catalog scope;
  - each preview is the set's own body, read with `client.get('permission', name)` through the console metadata client the page already uses. No union of sets is computed and nothing is editable (the preview gets no `onPatch`; the section holds no control);
  - a named set the server does not serve (`get` answers `null` on 404) shows one line, `Permission set "NAME" was not found.`, for that set only; the other previews still render;
  - a refused or failed read shows `Permission set "NAME" could not be read.` plus the server's sentence, not "not found": a refused read is not an absent set;
  - a position that names no sets shows `This position names no permission sets.` and reads nothing.
  - The names come from the page's draft (as `PositionPreview` above it reads them), and the read effect keys on the list's content, so editing another field does not re-read the sets.
- **`ResourceEditPage.tsx`**: `ENVIRONMENT_SECTIONS` maps a type to an ordered list of sections, each handed `{ name, draft }`; `position` is `[PositionHoldersSection, PositionPermissionSetsSection]`. `PositionHoldersSection` is unchanged and still reads only `name`.
- **`i18n.ts`**: 7 new `engine.position.sets.*` keys, en and zh, beside the existing `engine.position.*` block. No existing key changes.
- **`PermissionPreview.tsx`**: unchanged. Without `onPatch` it is already read-only, so no prop was needed.
- Changeset: `.changeset/26187-position-permission-preview.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

- New `PositionPermissionSetsSection.test.tsx` (6 tests): two named sets give two previews in declared order, each with its own objects and scopes (no union), each headed by the set name with the right href; read-only (no checkbox, combobox or button); a missing set gives one not-found line only for that set; a refused read is said as a refusal, not "not found"; no sets, and no `permissionSets` key, give the empty state and no read.
- New `ResourceEditPage.positionPermissionSets-26187.test.tsx` (3 tests): the Setup position page mounts the previews in order beside the holders; Studio (no scope) and another type in the Setup scope do not.
- Red first, ablation, green, the importer suite and the type-check are in Verification below.

## Acceptance notes

- **Declared sets only.** The section shows exactly the sets the definition names. The position-name fold (a set sharing the position's name) is retired on `main` (`.changeset/24757-retire-position-name-fold.md`), so the declared list is the whole grant; the list page's served `_grantedPermissionSets` column remains the server's own answer.
- **Draft, not saved state.** The names are read from the definition on screen, so an unsaved edit to `permissionSets` previews the edited list. The Setup position page renders read-only for a caller without `manage_metadata`, where the draft equals the stored definition.
- **Layout.** Under the designer, the environment sections share the existing bounded strip (`max-h-[35vh]`, scrolling), so several previews scroll inside it rather than squeezing the canvas.
- Card relation is declared once, in this body.
